---
title: "About"
---

We will study important fields foundational to machine learing:

- Optimization
- Statistics

We will review important python packages related to scientific programming and machine learning:

- NumPy
- SciPy
- pandas
- scikit-learn
- PyTorch
- Tensorflow

Finally, we can work on coding projects in python aimed at understanding 

- Foundational ML Problems
- Neural Networks (MLP, CNN, RNN, LSTM, GAN)
- LLMs (Transformers)

With these understood, we can move towards research in NNs/LLMs/Transformers.

Locally trained models are important to have, use of my research in distributed ML
can facilitate working with multiple locally trained models between yourself or peers
without need of a shared dataset. KD is a simple alternative.
